revised.alt: The revised order has no passing arrangement: Direct lacks capacity, Backup exceeds the spending boundary and Consolidated lacks current confirmation.
revised.caption: The compact comparison gives each arrangement its own condition to inspect.

scope.alt: The shipment desk shows Pending input changes and disables Recalculate while the edited confirmation remains a draft.
scope.caption: Apply or discard the edits before calculation. Reports describe the last applied inputs; the last proposal remains available separately.

updated.alt: After applying a genuine revision-2 slot confirmation, the same shipment calculation prefers Consolidated at $5,000.
updated.caption: Direct remains capacity-blocked and Backup remains over the expense limit. The current confirmation changes Consolidated’s eligibility.

baseline.alt: The native SDK Decision summary prefers Direct at $4,000 while the $5,000 Consolidated arrangement also meets the recorded requirements.
baseline.caption: At 8 a.m., Direct protects the delivery promise for less. The cost-first policy remains fixed.

late.alt: At 11:30 a.m., Direct is past its 11 a.m. booking cutoff and Consolidated is preferred at $5,000.
late.caption: The changed booking context justifies the $1,000 premium. The quotes and cost-first policy remain fixed.

chosen.alt: The operating handoff records a chosen shipment arrangement separately from sourced authority, reservation and delivery.
chosen.caption: A current complete feasible calculation supports a choice; it does not create operating authority.

completed.alt: Current authorization, a quote-linked reservation and accepted delivery of all units support the original shipment commitment.
completed.caption: The authored actual-event gate checks the supplied operating chain against the original promise.

cancelled.alt: A later negative carrier record withdraws support for the earlier reservation and original commitment completion.
cancelled.caption: The latest negative record supersedes the positive without erasing its history.

reserved.alt: Sourced authorization and a carrier reservation are recorded, while original delivery completion remains unestablished.
reserved.caption: A reservation is distinct from accepted delivery of the complete order.

pending.alt: The shipment desk shows Pending input changes and disables Recalculate while the edited confirmation remains a draft.
pending.caption: Apply or discard the edits before calculation. Reports describe the last applied inputs; the last proposal remains available separately.

stale.alt: The applied confirmation change marks the old shipment finding stale.
stale.caption: Changed inputs withdraw the earlier finding until Recalculate completes.

supporting.alt: Supporting reports inspect the exact Direct candidate and retain its complete conditions.
supporting.caption: Inspection opens the exact option without changing inputs, calculations or the operating choice.

process.alt: The authored shipment Decision process shows supported choices, blocked-case responses and a separate actual-record completion check.
process.caption: The SDK explains the business response and reassessment path from the same authored workflow.

dependencies.alt: Calculation dependencies show how the shipment arrangement assessment supplies the current summary and operating record checks.
dependencies.caption: Calculation dependencies expose result handoffs; inspecting them performs no booking or delivery.
